newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France December cargo traffic up 9.1p.
newsitem.headline: Air France December cargo traffic up 9.1p.

text.p: Air France recorded a 9.1 percent increase in cargo traffic in December 1996, with 438.6 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK), figures from the French national carrier show.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.

"In comparing last month with the same 1995 month, one should remember that December 1995 saw prolonged strike action by France's public sector which affected airlines activities including cargo. Clearly, this had an impact on the traffic growth rate for December 1996," an Air France cargo official told Reuters.
The overall cargo load factor in December 1996 was up 10.4 percent on the same month the previous year at 73.3 percent, the airline said.
In the first nine months of its current financial year - which runs from April 1 1996 to March 31 1997 - Air France transported 3.68 billion FTK, up 6.4 percent on April-November 1995.

Overall cargo load factor during April-December 1996 was up 6.3 percent on the same period the previous year at 68.7 percent, the airline added. Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax 44-171-542-5017
